items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 46:1
items.html: For the ten Sefirot of the NHY of AA were divided into three thirds — KHB, HGT, NHY — for each one of the NHY is divided into three joints. And the upper joint of Netzah ascended to the HGT, for the Mochin of nursing, which ZA does not take from during the time of his pregnancy; and two joints of Netzah remained below. And through the ascent of the NHY of AA to the HGT, they were included one in the other, and the middle joint of Netzah was found to be included also of Hesed; hence it includes Hesed-Netzah. For the middle joints of the Partzuf of the NHY of AA are the HGT, as above. Therefore the middle joint of Netzah, which is Hesed, is found — and through the inclusion of the NHY in the HGT, the Hesed includes also the phase of Netzah. (Item 50).
